<details>
The PKGBUILD file defines a standard build process for the tuxguitar-src package, which is a guitar tablature editor. It fetches source code from the project's official GitHub repository and downloads prebuilt SWT (Standard Widget Toolkit) binaries from Eclipse's official download server (`download.eclipse.org`). The checksums for all sources are explicitly provided and match the expected SHA-256 values, ensuring integrity.

The build uses Maven via a helper function `_mvn` with appropriate flags for non-interactive builds. During `prepare()`, it installs the local SWT JAR into the local Maven repository and replaces version placeholders (`9.99-SNAPSHOT`) with the actual package version in configuration files—both legitimate and expected steps for building this Java-based application. The `build()` function runs `mvn clean verify`, which is standard practice.

The `package()` function correctly installs built artifacts under `/usr/lib/tuxguitar`, creates a symlink in `/usr/bin`, and places desktop integration files in their proper system directories. All operations are confined to the package directory and follow Arch Linux packaging guidelines. There are no signs of obfuscated code, unauthorized network access, or malicious payloads.
</details>
